summary.text: N'Kiyla Thomas is the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Oklahoma. A nurse, Chickasaw citizen and military spouse from Ardmore, she describes herself as not a career politician. She says she is running on accessible healthcare, support for teachers and nurses, and services for families raising children with disabilities.

paragraphs.text: Thomas was born and raised in Ardmore, Oklahoma, and graduated from Ardmore High School. Her work experience includes nursing, work as a community health worker and time as a stay-at-home parent, and Ballotpedia lists her profession as nurse.
She has been affiliated with the Chickasaw Nation, autism support groups and advocacy, military spouse networks and veterans advocacy; her husband serves in the military.
In her Ballotpedia survey she says she is raising a neurodivergent child, which she cites as part of her motivation for running.
Thomas advanced to the general election by defeating Jim Priest in the Democratic primary runoff on August 25, 2026, after a June 16 primary that sent the race to a runoff.
